// NEGATIVE-CONTROL FIXTURE for BPAIR-003 (test/capability-guard.test.ts).
// Deliberately violates every capability-guard rule so the test can prove the
// walker actually flags violations. Plain-text (.ts.txt) so it is never
// compiled, typechecked, or executed — it is only read as text by the guard.
// DO NOT rename to .ts and DO NOT copy any line of this file into src/.

import { LiveClobAdapter } from "@b5p/polymarket"; // forbidden-package
import { ClobClient } from "@polymarket/clob-client"; // forbidden-package (scope prefix)
import { createWalletClient } from "viem"; // forbidden-package
import { Wallet } from "ethers"; // forbidden-package
import { execSync } from "node:child_process"; // forbidden-module
import { liveAdapter } from "../../../../polymarket/src/live"; // escapes-package + live segment
import { engineMain } from "../../../../../apps/engine/src/main"; // escapes-package

export async function reachForbiddenCapabilities(): Promise<void> {
  const wallet = await import("./wallet"); // live-or-wallet-segment (dynamic import)
  const cp = require("child_process"); // forbidden-module (require)
  void [LiveClobAdapter, ClobClient, createWalletClient, Wallet, execSync, liveAdapter, engineMain, wallet, cp];
}
